scope: Private native LINEAR RGB(A/X) common-WSI memory BO export without unnecessary guest CPU registration; ordinary Vulkan allocations and kernel budgets unchanged
qualified_bo_flags: USE_CROSS_DEVICE when existing renderer supports it
qualified_bo_flag_removed: USE_MAPPABLE only for fully qualified private internal native WSI memory

required_external_qualification.window_system: Private controller must select Wayland; classifier does not independently establish a Wayland display or completed feedback callbacks.

preserved: Ordinary application textures/uniform buffers and general HOST_VISIBLE allocations
DMA-BUF export handle types and SHAREABLE/CROSS_DEVICE flag derivation
Vulkan allocation flags and published memory types
Existing source/destination image and Gunyah byte/span guards
license: MIT; original complete Mesa notices retained
qualification: Exact process token and existing8d qualified explicit feedback token
Common WSI private-memory allocation tag and dedicated exact image
Image internally created by vn_wsi_create_image; external swapchain aliases never inherit bit
DMA_BUF-only image and allocation export; DMA_BUF renderer handle type
No imported allocation, existing image memory, protected/unknown image flags
limitations: Source and host stand-ins do not prove guest PRIME/EGL GPU import, syncfd behavior or native presentation with nonmappable BOs.
Eight host bridge slots and4096 Gunyah spans remain; other simultaneous workloads may still saturate them.
Opportunistic suppression applies only to qualified private image BO transport; ordinary mapped textures/uniforms still consume registration spans.
Memory-type advertisement and native VkMemoryAllocateInfo are unchanged; Vulkan memory is private common-WSI storage not exposed as an application VkDeviceMemory.
Unexpected vkMapMemory of private storage refuses before any renderer BO creation or remapping; no automatic fallback.

Exact8d feedback token and resultingLINEAR image are checked, but actual completed Wayland feedback/device evidence is enforced by the pinned8d allocation selector and controller; explicitly opted-in X11 common-WSI could otherwise meet classifier fields.

host_validation.scope: Actual patched Mesa functions and structs with GPU/device/allocation/transport stand-ins; Vulkan/DRM headers from pinned Mesa source; no full Mesa build or device validation

build_notes: Initial compile found-Werror=switch on private Mesa structure tag; revision2 handles that tag before the standard Vulkan enum switch.

selection_diagnostic.scope: Successful qualified private renderer BO creation only

runtime_scope: Qualified private BO allocation path and owned API/compute workloads only; concurrent native animation/recovery fails sampled visual checks
